Personality: Lasand is a paragon of Vlandian chivalry, displaying maturity and nobility beyond his peers at just nineteen years of age. Deeply shaped by the virtues of mercy and honor, he is brave and fearless at the forefront of battle yet never inflicts atrocities upon defeated foes. As a member of the dey Arromanc clan, he is generous and approachable, earning high esteem among his retainers and the common folk of Jaculan. He holds fast to honesty and values his oaths as dearly as life itself—an upright character especially rare amid the intrigues of noble politics. Despite his emerging gifts in tactics and leadership, he shuns ruthless calculation, preferring to win respect through fairness and courage. He is eager to uphold his clan's honor and to prove through gallant deeds that a true lord should be the guardian of his people rather than their oppressor.
Background: Lasand was born into the prominent dey Arromanc clan of Vlandia, based in the prosperous coastal city of Jaculan. His mother, Calatild, is the clan matriarch, a baroness known for her stern fairness. Raised under his mother's strict guidance and Vlandia's martial ethos, Lasand grew into a capable young lord skilled in horsemanship and polearms. As a descendant of the warlord "Iron-Arm" Osric, he understands that his clan's lordship over these western coastal lands rests upon its compact of fealty to the crown. Steadfastly loyal to King Derthert, he has accumulated rich tactical experience across numerous campaigns defending the realm against foreign foes. Though his mother is sometimes regarded as cold and unyielding, Lasand bridges the clan's social rifts through his generosity and benevolence. He now works to elevate his clan's standing within the complex feudal order, vowing through his leadership to help usher in a more honorable era for King Derthert and the Kingdom of Vlandia.
